entries.title: The Flash

violence.summary: Frequent superhero peril includes Barry's mother being fatally stabbed, a destructive chase with explosions and injuries, newborns falling from a collapsing hospital, a tortured Kryptonian prisoner, large battles with deaths, and repeated timeline-trauma scenes.

language.summary: Language is stronger than many superhero entries, with one prominent F-word, frequent S-word use, crude body-part terms, and other mild-to-moderate profanity.

romance.summary: Romance is mostly crushes and flirtation, but nonsexual partial nudity is extended when super-speed strips young Barry's clothes and he repeatedly covers himself in public.

drinking.summary: Adults occasionally drink wine or beer, and one character takes a bar shot.

handoffNotes: Live CSM language and romance labels are higher than the current catalog prose implies; reviewer should preserve the updated labels if importing.
Barry's grief over his murdered mother and the repeated failed attempts to change loss may need emotional-content prose.
